body: Body cam footage of 4PF Poppy aka Marquis Davis getting arrested by Atlanta police for his alleged connection in the shooting of San Francisco 49ers defensive lineman Keion White at a Super Bowl party following an argument with Lil Baby’s crew. Allegations are not findings of guilt.
